_om: Samleren in English (Collector, rusj.no/en/collector/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen legger ut det den ser og kaster: The phone lays down whatever it spots and discards a bit at random. Good for learning.
Mobilen tenker over hvert kort den kaste: The phone thinks about every card it discards, but slips up now and then.
Mobilen teller kort, husker hva dere tar: The phone counts cards, remembers what you pick up and feeds nobody. Can you beat it?
Sett og rekker – bli kvitt kortene først: Sets and runs – be first to go out
For to – bank på med ti eller mindre: For two – knock with ten or less
Én runde – den som vinner runden, vinner: One round – whoever wins the round wins.
Vinneren av hver runde får poeng. Først: The winner of each round scores points. First to 100 wins.
Poengene fra hver runde legges sammen. F: The points from every round are added up. First to 250 wins.
The points from every round are added up. First to 500 wins.
The discard pile has been turned over into a new pile.
Vil du ha {kort}? Ellers går tilbudet vi: Do you want the {kort}? If not, the offer passes on.
Nobody wanted the card. Draw from the pile.
Du tar {antall} og må legge ut {kort} me: You take {antall} and must lay down the {kort} straight away.
Bunken er tom. Ta fra kastebunken, eller: The pile is empty. Take from the discard pile, or end the round.
Trekk fra bunken, eller ta kort fra kast: Draw from the pile, or take cards from the discard pile.
Draw from the pile, or take the {kort}.
Kaster du {kort}, har du gin!: Discard the {kort} and you have gin!
Kaster du {kort}, har du {n} løse poeng: Discard the {kort} and you have {n} in deadwood – you can knock.
Kortet du nettopp tok, kan du ikke kaste: You can't discard the card you just took.
Velg kortet du vil kaste. Løse poeng nå:: Choose a card to discard. Deadwood now: {n}.
Legg ut {kort} nå – i en ny kombinasjon: Lay down the {kort} now – in a new meld or on the table.
Passer på bordet: trykk på det som lyser: It fits on the table: tap the meld that lights up – or discard the card.
It fits on the table: tap the meld that lights up.
Ikke en kombinasjon ennå: tre eller fire: Not a meld yet: three or four of a kind, or three in a row in the same suit.
Velg kort å legge ut – eller ett kort å: Pick cards to lay down – or one card to discard.
The pile ran out – nobody wins the round.
Du hadde færre løse poeng – du vinner ru: You had less deadwood – you win the round!
{navn} hadde færre løse poeng og vinner: {navn} had less deadwood and wins the round!
Du banket på og vinner runden!: You knocked and win the round!
Du ble kvitt alle kortene!: You got rid of all your cards!
{navn} ble kvitt alle kortene!: {navn} got rid of all their cards!
No melds on the table yet.
Samle kortene i sett og rekker og legg d: Collect your cards in sets and runs and lay them down on the table. Choose plain rummy, 500 or gin rummy for two.
Ta det øverste kortet fra bunken eller f: Take the top card of the pile or of the discard pile.
Tre eller fire like (et sett) eller tre: Three or four of a kind (a set), or three or more in a row in the same suit (a run). Tap the cards, then ‘Lay down’. Single cards can be laid off on melds already on the table.
Avslutt turen med å kaste ett kort. Kort: End your turn by discarding one card. You can't throw back the card you've just taken from the discard pile.
Rummy: To spillere får ti kort, tre elle: Rummy: two players get ten cards each, three or four get seven. The first to get rid of every card scores for the cards the others are left holding: picture cards 10, aces 1, the rest what they show.
Rummy: Ess er lavt (A-2-3). Tar bunken s: Rummy: aces are low (A-2-3). If the pile runs out, the discard pile is turned over to make a new one.
500: To spillere får 13 kort, tre eller: 500: two players get 13 cards each, three or four get seven. The discard pile is spread out, and you may take a card further down – you get every card above it too, and the bottom one must be laid down straight away.
500: Alt du legger ut, gir poeng – også: 500: everything you lay down scores – including cards you lay off on other people's melds. Whatever is left in your hand counts against you. Aces 15 (1 in A-2-3), picture cards and tens 10, the rest what they show.
500: Ess kan være høyt (Q-K-A) eller lav: 500: aces can be high (Q-K-A) or low (A-2-3). The round ends when someone runs out of cards, or when the pile is empty.
Gin rummy: To spillere, ti kort hver, og: Gin rummy: two players, ten cards each, and nothing is laid down during play. Cards that aren't part of a set or a run are deadwood.
Gin rummy: Har du ti eller færre løse po: Gin rummy: if you have ten or less in deadwood after discarding, you can knock. Both hands are shown, and the other player can lay off deadwood on your melds. The lower count wins the difference.
Gin rummy: Ingen løse kort er gin – 25 p: Gin rummy: no deadwood at all is gin – 25 points extra. If the other player has as little deadwood as you or less when you knock, they get the difference and 25 extra.
Flere på én mobil: Kortene skjules mello: Several on one phone: the cards are hidden between turns. Tap ‘Show my cards’ once you've got the phone.
Gin rummy er for to. Kortene skjules mel: Gin rummy is for two. The cards are hidden between turns.
Kortene skjules mellom hver tur, så inge: The cards are hidden between turns, so nobody sees anyone else's.
Godt kjempa! Neste gang går samlingen di: Well fought! Next time your collection will come good.
Du har trukket – legg ut eller kast: You've drawn – lay down or discard
Du kan bare ta {kort} hvis du kan legge: You can only take the {kort} if you can lay it down straight away
Velg kortene du vil legge til først: Pick the cards you want to lay off first
Kortet du nettopp tok, kan du ikke kaste: You can't discard the card you just took
Du har for mange løse poeng til å banke: You have too much deadwood to knock
Jeg slo mobilen i {spill} på Samleren ({: I beat the phone at {spill} on Collector ({niva}), {stilling}. Can you do better?
Mobilen slo meg i {spill} på Samleren ({: The phone beat me at {spill} on Collector ({niva}), {stilling}. Can you do better?
{navn} vant {spill} på Samleren ({stilli: {navn} won {spill} on Collector ({stilling})! Have a go yourself.
Dere går til kåringen. Runden dere er mi: You'll go to the results. The round you're in the middle of doesn't count.
You can always start a new one.
